rules.rule: Any promised discount above 10% needs a written pre-approval recorded in the deal desk tool before it can be mentioned to the customer. Approval authority: VP of Sales.
24/7 or after-hours support may only be promised on Enterprise Plan deals. Check the SKU on the quote before making any availability commitment.
Data location commitments beyond the signup region require a legal sign-off entry in the compliance register before signature.
Uptime commitments above 99.5% are reserved for Enterprise Plan quotes. Any higher figure requires a signed exception from Engineering.
Refund offers on early termination contradict the MSA; finance cannot process them. Escalate to Legal instead of promising money back.
